note:
The other half of the rule, and the reason it is not simply "drop anything without a Task tag". This repository was found ONLY through `topic:wind-energy`, which `sources.yaml` lists under `generic_routes` — the same route, and the same lack of attribution, as the excluded repository in x-13. What saves it is that its README cites the IEA Wind 15 MW reference turbine's Zenodo deposit, which the catalogue holds: limb 2, `cites`. The evidence names the record cited.

Note the order the limbs are tried in. Limb 1 is checked first and is stronger, so a record with an attributing route never reports `cites` even when it also cites something — which is why this fixture's repository has no attributing route at all, and why the reference turbine beside it reports `direct` through its IEA Wind Zenodo community rather than `cited-by`.

One stated edge fills both directions: if A's references name B then A cites B and B is cited by A. That matters because Crossref publishes reference lists but not citing-work lists, so one side's metadata has to settle the question for both.
